# Staging QA rerun: C-221205reth

Date: 2026-10-26 07:46 CDT

Target: https://staging.capbar.pages.dev/

## Original failure and resolution

The supplied QA report failed before testing the site because Playwright looked for Chromium under `/root/.cache/ms-playwright`, where the executable was absent. Chromium is installed on this runner under `/opt/ms-playwright`. Reran the browser checks with `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/opt/ms-playwright`; Chromium launched successfully. No site code change was indicated by the failure.
